project.name: Queue status UI
project.brief: Allocate coherent pixel-art Working, Ready, Retry and Paused status assets for shared 16x16 queue cells while preserving the existing Start vector. Review a representative sample before family expansion; this allocation performs no asset generation.

included: Read BRIEF.md and SOURCE-MAP.md in full; re-read the changed brief, queue-state and queue-view source for this refresh.
Resolve the local ./queue type import and trace started/ok/error/pause through stateAfter to running/succeeded/failed/paused visual descriptors.
Trace both statusCell and compactStatus to the same statusVisuals map; allocate one shared asset per status rather than duplicate assets per consumer.
Inspect the only checked-in art, assets/start.svg, at source level for shape, dimensions and accent; verify the four current PNG destinations are absent.
Reconcile the Retry destination move to assets/error-retry.png while preserving its queue.retry ID and unchanged failure/retry purpose.
Capture unchanged display.cell, scale, nearest filtering, frameMs and dark-panel color from the supplied view descriptor.

Current refresh: re-read BRIEF.md line 9 and src/queue-view.ts; retain queue.ready ID while moving its destination to assets/ready-confirmed.png and promoting the explicitly required asymmetrical-arm check mark. Other states and Start unchanged.

Render stage and renderer recheck: ran renderer/capture.mjs (historical) and the separately versioned renderer-recheck/capture.mjs (HeadlessChrome 156, DPR 1, 1280x1000 device metrics set via CDP before navigation) against the actual src/queue.ts and src/queue-view.ts for every statusVisuals state in both statusCell and compactStatus at 1x and 3x; checked identities, screenshot/canvas correspondence, alpha compositing and nearest blocks with check.py (historical 95/104 explained; recheck 104/104); inspected the retained PNGs and derived crops visually; the caller ran an independent recheck capture with byte-identical output.
excluded: Server-registry account badges returned by accountBadge are explicitly outside this local request; do not allocate replacement badge art.
No images are allocated for stateAfter or other functions without a visual role; the queue transitions determine status meaning only.
No new Start control, panel background, font, text label, host configuration, generated art or provider operation is assigned.
unresolved: The representative renderer (renderer/, and the separately versioned renderer-recheck/ whose capture.mjs sets device metrics before navigation) is a scoped headless-Chrome fixture importing the real view modules; it is not the production UI. The original renderer/capture.mjs measured DOM bounds at a 1262x904 viewport while Chromium screenshotted at 1280x1000, so renderer/check.py failed 9 of 104 checks (dx=+9 bookkeeping offset, no rendering defect); renderer-recheck/check.py passes 104/104 on pixel-identical canvases. Production-host display acceptance (other browsers, DPR, zoom, the real shell) remains unverified.

Style baseline: the delivered Ready fixture is a controlled pixellab-test sample (provider_simulated=true). Adopting it as the family style reference establishes edge treatment, stroke weight, fill/colour role, margin/footprint and alpha policy only; it does not establish the other members' silhouettes, motion or meaning, non-colour distinction, family continuity, nor actual PixelLab output quality.
The account badge registry is populated remotely and is not enumerable from this checkout; badges remain excluded.

Working, Retry and Paused have no artwork, no production store, no candidate and no review; the renderer shows 'Missing asset' for them. Timed loop playback at 100 ms can only be observed interactively (node renderer-recheck/server.mjs) because the capture samples frame boundaries, not real-time playback. No PX2 family plan exists yet.
